name: Chiruko
source: One of the characters of the Correctness storyline. A detective in the 24th Ward's Heinous Crimes Unit. Has psychic powers, which she uses during the investigation. She is apparently addicted to Starbucks coffee and will start saying "doink" at the end of her sentences if she goes too long without it.
